intro.en: Arabs have many proverbs. Some come from before Islam and some from the time of Islam. Each proverb has a short story behind it, and people use the proverb when something similar happens. Here are the stories in short.
intro.ur: Arab ke paas bohat si amsaal (muhaware) hain. Kuch Islam se pehle ki hain aur kuch Islam ke daur ki. Har misaal ke peeche ek chhoti kahani hoti hai, aur jab koi aisi baat ho to log woh misaal bolte hain. Yahan kahaniyan mukhtasar di gayi hain.
intro.ar: لِلْعَرَبِ أَمْثالٌ كَثيرَةٌ، بَعْضُها مِنَ الجاهِلِيَّةِ وَبَعْضُها مِنَ الإِسْلامِ. وَلِكُلِّ مَثَلٍ قِصَّةٌ قَصيرَةٌ وَراءَهُ، وَيَقولُهُ النّاسُ حينَ يَحْدُثُ شَيْءٌ مُشابِهٌ. هُنا القِصَصُ مُخْتَصَرَةً.

dialogue.ar: لِلْعَرَبِ ثَرْوَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ مِنَ الأَمْثالِ، مِنْها ما قيلَ في الجاهِلِيَّةِ، وَمِنْها ما نَشَأَ في ظِلِّ الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: lilʿarabi tharwatun kabīratun mina l-ʾamthāl, minhā mā qīla fī l-jāhiliyyati, waminhā mā nashaʾa fī ẓilli l-ʾislām.
dialogue.en: The Arabs have a great wealth of proverbs; some were said in the pre-Islamic era and some arose in the shade of Islam.
dialogue.ur: Arabon ke paas muhawron ka bara khazana hai; kuch jahiliyyat mein kahe gaye aur kuch Islam ke saye mein wujood mein aaye.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ الأَوَّلُ: «جَزاءُ سِنِمّارَ». كَلَّفَ النُّعْمانُ، مَلِكُ الحيرَةِ، مُهَنْدِساً اسْمُهُ سِنِمّارُ بِتَشْييدِ قَصْرٍ ضَخْمٍ لَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu l-ʾawwal: jazāʾu sinimmār. kallafa n-nuʿmān, maliku l-ḥīrati, muhandisan smuhu sinimmāru bitashīīdi qaṣrin ḍakhmin lah.
dialogue.en: First proverb: "The reward of Sinimmar." An-Nu'man, king of al-Hira, commissioned an engineer called Sinimmar to erect a huge palace for him.
dialogue.ur: Pehla muhawara: "Sinimmar ka sila." Hira ke badshah Nu'man ne Sinimmar naam ke engineer ko apna ek azeem mahal tameer karne ka kaam diya.

dialogue.ar: أَبْدَعَ سِنِمّارُ في بِناءِ القَصْرِ، وَلَمّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ وَقَفَ مَعَ المَلِكِ عَلى سَطْحِهِ يَنْتَظِرُ المُكافَأَةَ.
dialogue.tr: abdaʿa sinimmāru fī bināʾi l-qaṣr, walammā faragha minhu waqafa maʿa l-maliki ʿalā saṭḥihi yantaẓiru l-mukāfaʾata.
dialogue.en: Sinimmar did wonders in building the palace, and when he finished he stood with the king on its roof waiting for his reward.
dialogue.ur: Sinimmar ne mahal ki tameer mein kamal kar diya aur jab farigh hua to badshah ke saath chhat par khara inaam ka muntazir tha.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ المَلِكَ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ المُهَنْدِسُ مِثْلَهُ لِمَلِكٍ آخَرَ، فَدَفَعَهُ مِنَ السَّطْحِ. وَيُقالُ المَثَلُ لِمَنْ يَرُدُّ الإِحْسانَ بِالإِساءَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lākin l-malika khashiya an yabniya l-muhandisu mithlahu limalikin ʾākhar, fadafaʿahu mina s-saṭḥ. wayuqālu l-mathalu liman yaruddu l-ʾiḥsāna bi-l-ʾisāʾati.
dialogue.en: But the king feared that the engineer might build the like of it for another king, so he pushed him off the roof. The proverb is said of one who repays kindness with harm.
dialogue.ur: Lekin badshah ko andesha hua ke engineer kisi aur badshah ke liye aisa hi mahal bana dega, to us ne use chhat se gira diya. Yeh muhawara us ke liye kaha jata hai jo bhalai ka badla burai se de.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ الثّاني: «رَجَعَ بِخُفَّيْ حُنَيْنٍ». في الحيرَةِ كانَ إِسْكافِيٌّ مَشْهورٌ يُدْعى حُنَيْناً، جاءَهُ أَعْرابِيٌّ لِيَشْتَريَ خُفَّيْنِ فَطالَ جِدالُهُ في السِّعْرِ حَتّى أَغْضَبَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu th-thānī: rajaʿa bikhuffay ḥunaynin. fī l-ḥīrati kāna iskāfiyyun mashhūrun yudʿā ḥunaynan, jāʾahu aʿrābiyyun liyashtarya khuffayni faṭāla jidāluhu fī s-siʿri ḥattā aghḍabah.
dialogue.en: Second proverb: "He returned with Hunayn's two shoes." In al-Hira there was a well-known cobbler called Hunayn. A Bedouin came to buy a pair of shoes and his haggling over the price went on until he made him angry.
dialogue.ur: Doosra muhawara: "Hunain ke jootay lekar laut aaya." Hunain Hira ka mashhoor mochi tha. Ek dehati jootay kharidne aaya aur qeemat par itni bahas ki ke us ko ghussa dila diya.

dialogue.ar: خَرَجَ الأَعْرابِيُّ بِلا شِراءٍ، فَسَبَقَهُ حُنَيْنٌ مِنْ طَريقٍ مُخْتَصَرَةٍ وَأَلْقى أَحَدَ الخُفَّيْنِ عَلى الدَّرْبِ، ثُمَّ أَلْقى الآخَرَ بَعيداً عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: kharaja l-ʾaʿrābiyyu bilā shirāʾin, fasabaqahu ḥunaynun min ṭarīqin mukhtaṣaratin waʾalqā aḥada l-khuffayni ʿalā d-darb, thumma alqā l-ʾākhara baʿīdan ʿanh.
dialogue.en: The Bedouin left without buying, so Hunayn got ahead of him by a short cut and threw one shoe on the path, then threw the other one far from it.
dialogue.ur: Dehati bina kharide chala gaya to Hunain chhote raaste se aage nikal gaya, ek joota raaste mein phenka aur doosra us se door phenk diya.

dialogue.ar: مَرَّ الأَعْرابِيُّ بِالأَوَّلِ وَتَرَكَهُ، فَلَمّا وَجَدَ الثّانِيَ عادَ لِيَأْخُذَ الأَوَّلَ وَتَرَكَ ناقَتَهُ، فَسَرَقَها حُنَيْنٌ. فَرَجَعَ إِلى أَهْلِهِ بِالخُفَّيْنِ وَحْدَهُما، وَيُقالُ المَثَلُ لِمَنْ يَعودُ خائِباً.
dialogue.tr: marra l-ʾaʿrābiyyu bi-l-ʾawwali watarakah, falammā wajada th-thāniya ʿāda liyaʾkhudha l-ʾawwala wataraka nāqatah, fasaraqahā ḥunaynun. farajaʿa ilā ahlihi bi-l-khuffayni waḥdahumā, wayuqālu l-mathalu liman yaʿūdu khāʾiban.
dialogue.en: The Bedouin passed the first shoe and left it; when he found the second he went back to take the first and left his camel, which Hunayn stole. He went home to his family with only the two shoes, and the proverb is said of one who returns disappointed.
dialogue.ur: Dehati pehle joote ke paas se guzar gaya, jab doosra mila to pehla lene wapas gaya aur apni untni chhor gaya jise Hunain le gaya. Woh sirf jootay lekar ghar lauta; yeh muhawara nakaam laut aane wale ke liye kaha jata hai.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ الثّالِثُ: «مَواعيدُ عُرْقوبٍ». كانَ عُرْقوبٌ كَثيرَ الوُعودِ قَليلَ الوَفاءِ، فَسَأَلَهُ أَخوهُ ثَمَرَ نَخْلَتِهِ، فَقالَ: تَعالَ حينَ تُزْهِرُ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu th-thālith: maūāʿīdu ʿurqūbin. kāna ʿurqūbun kathīra l-wuʿūdi qalīla l-wafāʾ, fasaʾalahu akhūhu thamara nakhlatih, faqāl: taʿāla ḥīna tuzhir.
dialogue.en: Third proverb: "The promises of Urqub." Urqub made many promises and kept few. His brother asked him for the fruit of his palm tree, and he said: Come when it blossoms.
dialogue.ur: Teesra muhawara: "Urqub ke wade." Urqub wade bohat karta aur nibhata kam tha. Us ke bhai ne khajoor ke phal maange to bola: Jab phool aayen tab aana.

dialogue.ar: فَجاءَ أَخوهُ حينَ أَزْهَرَتْ، فَقالَ: اِصْبِرْ حَتّى تُصْبِحَ بَلَحاً، ثُمَّ حَتّى تَنْضَجَ رُطَباً، ثُمَّ حَتّى تَيْبَسَ تَمْراً.
dialogue.tr: fajāʾa akhūhu ḥīna azharat, faqāl: iṣbir ḥattā tuṣbiḥa balaḥan, thumma ḥattā tanḍaja ruṭaban, thumma ḥattā taybasa tamran.
dialogue.en: His brother came when it blossomed, and he said: Wait until it becomes unripe dates, then until it ripens into fresh dates, then until it dries into dried dates.
dialogue.ur: Bhai phool aane par aaya to bola: Sabr karo yahan tak ke kacchi khajoor ban jaye, phir taaza pak jaye, phir sookh kar chhuhara bane.

dialogue.ar: وَفي لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ عُرْقوبٌ الثَّمَرَ كُلَّهُ وَلَمْ يُعْطِ أَخاهُ شَيْئاً، فَصارَ المَثَلُ يُقالُ لِمَنْ يُخْلِفُ وَعْدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wafī laylatin jamaʿa ʿurqūbun th-thamara kullahu walam yuʿṭi akhāhu shayʾan, faṣāra l-mathalu yuqālu liman yukhlifu waʿdah.
dialogue.en: One night Urqub gathered all the fruit and gave his brother nothing, so the proverb came to be said of one who breaks his promise.
dialogue.ur: Ek raat Urqub ne saara phal utaar liya aur bhai ko kuch na diya, is liye yeh muhawara wada khilafi karne wale ke liye kaha jata hai.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ الرّابِعُ: «الصَّيْفَ ضَيَّعْتِ اللَّبَنَ». كانَ شَيْخٌ ثَرِيٌّ شَحيحٌ مُتَزَوِّجاً بِامْرَأَةٍ شابَّةٍ، وَلَمْ يَتَفاهَما، فَطَلَبَتْ مِنْهُ الطَّلاقَ في الشِّتاءِ فَطَلَّقَها.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu r-rābiʿ: aṣ-ṣayfa ḍayyaʿti l-laban. kāna shaykhun thariyyun shaḥīḥun mutazawwijan biāmraʾatin shābbatin, walam yatafāhamā, faṭalabat minhu ṭ-ṭalāqa fī sh-shitāʾi faṭallaqahā.
dialogue.en: Fourth proverb: "In summer you lost the milk." A rich, stingy old man was married to a young woman, and they did not get along, so she asked him for a divorce in winter and he divorced her.
dialogue.ur: Chautha muhawara: "Garmi mein tum ne doodh zaya kar diya." Ek ameer kanjoos boorha ek jawan aurat se shadi shuda tha, dono mein na bani, to us ne sardiyon mein talaq maangi aur us ne de di.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا جاءَ الصَّيْفُ وَاشْتَدَّ الحَرُّ وَقَلَّ اللَّبَنُ، أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ تَطْلُبُ شَيْئاً مِنْ لَبَنِهِ.
dialogue.tr: falammā jāʾa ṣ-ṣayfu wāshtadda l-ḥarru waqalla l-laban, arsalat ilayhi taṭlubu shayʾan min labanih.
dialogue.en: When summer came, the heat grew strong and milk became scarce, she sent to him asking for some of his milk.
dialogue.ur: Jab garmi aayi, tapish barhi aur doodh kam ho gaya to us ne use paigham bheja ke apne doodh mein se kuch de.

dialogue.ar: فَرَدَّ عَلَيْها: «الصَّيْفَ ضَيَّعْتِ اللَّبَنَ». وَيُقالُ المَثَلُ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الشَّيْءَ في غَيْرِ أَوانِهِ.
dialogue.tr: faradda ʿalayhā: aṣ-ṣayfa ḍayyaʿti l-laban. wayuqālu l-mathalu liman yaṭlubu sh-shayʾa fī ghayri aūānih.
dialogue.en: He replied: "In summer you lost the milk." The proverb is said of one who asks for something at the wrong time.
dialogue.ur: Us ne jawab diya: "Garmi mein tum ne doodh zaya kar diya." Yeh muhawara us ke liye kaha jata hai jo cheez beqt maange.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ الخامِسُ: «عَلى أَهْلِها جَنَتْ بَراقِشُ». كانَتْ بَراقِشُ كَلْبَةً عِنْدَ قَوْمٍ يَسْكُنونَ مَكاناً خَفِيّاً، فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ خُصومُهُمْ لَيْلاً وَلَمْ يَعْرِفوا أَيْنَ بُيوتُهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu l-khāmis: ʿalā ahlihā janat barāqish. kānat barāqishu kalbatan ʿinda qawmin yaskunūna makānan khafiyyan, faʾaqbala ʿalayhim khuṣūmuhum laylan walam yaʿrifū ayna bīūtuhum.
dialogue.en: Fifth proverb: "Baraqish harmed her own people." Baraqish was a dog belonging to a people who lived in a hidden place. Their enemies came upon them at night and did not know where their homes were.
dialogue.ur: Paanchwan muhawara: "Baraqish ne apne hi logon par jurm kiya." Baraqish ek kutiya thi jo ek chhupi hui jagah rehne wali qaum ke paas thi. Un ke dushman raat ko aaye aur nahin jante the ke un ke ghar kahan hain.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ هَمُّوا بِالرُّجوعِ سَمِعوا نُباحَ الكَلْبَةِ فَاهْتَدَوْا بِهِ إِلى القَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna hammū bi-r-rujūʿi samiʿū nubāḥa l-kalbati fāhtadawā bihi ilā l-qawm.
dialogue.en: When they were about to turn back, they heard the dog barking and were guided by it to the people.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh wapas jane lage to kutiya ka bhonkna suna aur us ki aawaz se qaum tak pohanch gaye.

dialogue.ar: فَهاجَموهُمْ وَغَلَبوهُمْ، وَصارَ المَثَلُ يُقالُ لِمَنْ يَجْلِبُ الشَّرَّ عَلى نَفْسِهِ وَأَهْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fahājamūhum waghalabūhum, waṣāra l-mathalu yuqālu liman yajlibu sh-sharra ʿalā nafsihi waʾahlih.
dialogue.en: They attacked them and overcame them, and the proverb came to be said of one who brings evil on himself and his family.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne hamla kiya aur un par ghalib aa gaye; yeh muhawara us ke liye kaha jata hai jo apne aur apne ghar walon par museebat laye.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ السّادِسُ: «قَطَعَتْ جَهيزَةُ قَوْلَ كُلِّ خَطيبٍ». وَقَعَتْ جَريمَةُ قَتْلٍ بَيْنَ قَبيلَتَيْنِ، فَتَنادى الوُجَهاءُ مِنَ الجانِبَيْنِ إِلى مَجْلِسٍ يَتَحَدَّثونَ فيهِ عَنِ الصُّلْحِ وَيَمْنَعونَ الثَّأْرَ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu s-sādis: qaṭaʿat jahīzatu qawla kulli khaṭībin. waqaʿat jarīmatu qatlin bayna qabīlatayn, fatanādā l-wujahāʾu mina l-jānibayni ilā majlisin yataḥaddathūna fīhi ʿani ṣ-ṣulḥi wayamnaʿūna th-thaʾr.
dialogue.en: Sixth proverb: "Jahiza cut off the speech of every orator." A man from one tribe killed a man from another tribe, so the notables gathered to speak about peace and preventing revenge.
dialogue.ur: Chhata muhawara: "Jahiza ne har khatib ki baat kaat di." Ek qabile ke aadmi ne doosre qabile ke aadmi ko qatl kar diya, to maazizeen sulah aur inteqam rokne par baat karne jama hue.

dialogue.ar: وَبَيْنَما هُمْ يَخْطُبونَ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ اسْمُها جَهيزَةُ وَقالَتْ: لَقَدْ قَتَلَ أَهْلُ القَتيلِ القاتِلَ لِتَوِّهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wabaynamā hum yakhṭubūna dakhalati mraʾatun smuhā jahīzatu wa qālat: laqad qatala ahlu l-qatīli l-qātila litawwihim.
dialogue.en: While they were speaking, a woman named Jahiza came in and said: The victim's family have just killed the killer.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh taqreerein kar rahe the ek aurat Jahiza naam ki aayi aur boli: Maqtool ke ghar walon ne abhi abhi qatil ko maar diya hai.

dialogue.ar: فَسَكَتَ المُتَكَلِّمونَ، وَأَصْبَحَ هذا القَوْلُ مَثَلاً يُضْرَبُ لِمَنْ يَقْطَعُ كَلامَ النّاسِ بِخَبَرٍ مُفاجِئٍ.
dialogue.tr: fasakata l-mutakallimūn, waʾaṣbaḥa hādhā l-qawlu mathalan yuḍrabu liman yaqṭaʿu kalāma n-nāsi bikhabarin mufājiʾin.
dialogue.en: The speakers fell silent, and this saying became a proverb said of one who interrupts people's talk with a sudden piece of news.
dialogue.ur: Taqreer karne wale khamosh ho gaye aur yeh jumla muhawara ban gaya jo us ke liye kaha jata hai jo achanak khabar de kar logon ki baat kaat de.

dialogue.ar: المَثَلُ السّابِعُ: «وَعِنْدَ جُهَيْنَةَ الخَبَرُ اليَقينُ». سافَرَ رَجُلٌ مَعَ رَفيقٍ مِنْ قَبيلَةِ جُهَيْنَةَ وَلَمْ يَعُدْ، فَأَخَذَتْ أُخْتُهُ تَسْأَلُ كُلَّ مَنْ تَلْقاهُ عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-mathalu s-sābiʿ: waʿinda juhaynata l-khabaru l-yaqīn. sāfara rajulun maʿa rafīqin min qabīlati juhaynata walam yaʿud, faʾakhadhat ukhtuhu tasʾalu kulla man talqāhu ʿanh.
dialogue.en: Seventh proverb: "With Juhayna is the sure news." A man travelled with a companion from the tribe of Juhayna and did not return, so his sister began asking everyone she met about him.
dialogue.ur: Satwan muhawara: "Juhaina ke paas yaqeeni khabar hai." Ek shakhs Juhaina qabile ke saathi ke saath safar par gaya aur wapas na aaya, to us ki behan jis se milti us se us ke baare mein poochti.

dialogue.ar: فَدَلَّها النّاسُ عَلى جُهَيْنَةَ، فَعَلِمَتِ الحَقيقَةَ مِنْ أَهْلِها. فَصارَ المَثَلُ يُقالُ عِنْدَ البَحْثِ عَنْ حَقيقَةِ الأَمْرِ.
dialogue.tr: fadallahā n-nāsu ʿalā juhaynata, faʿalimati l-ḥaqīqata min ahlihā. faṣāra l-mathalu yuqālu ʿinda l-baḥthi ʿan ḥaqīqati l-ʾamr.
dialogue.en: People pointed her to Juhayna, and she learned the truth from its people. So the proverb is said when searching for the truth of a matter.
dialogue.ur: Logon ne use Juhaina ki taraf rehnumai ki aur us ne un ke ghar walon se sachchai jaan li. Is liye yeh muhawara baat ki haqeeqat maloom karte waqt kaha jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا تَحْفَظُ الأَمْثالُ تَجارِبَ الأَجْيالِ في كَلِماتٍ قَليلَةٍ يَسْهُلُ حِفْظُها.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā taḥfaẓu l-ʾamthālu tajāriba l-ʾajīāli fī kalimātin qalīlatin yashulu ḥifẓuhā.
dialogue.en: In this way proverbs preserve the experiences of generations in a few words that are easy to memorise.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah muhawre naslon ke tajurbe thore se alfaz mein mehfooz kar lete hain jinhein yaad karna aasaan hota hai.

q.en: Which proverb is said to someone who repays kindness with harm?
q.ur: Kaun si misaal us ke liye bolte hain jo bhalai ka badla burai se de?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَثَلٍ يُقالُ لِمَنْ يُقابِلُ الإِحْسانَ بِالإِساءَةِ؟

q.en: Which proverb is said to someone who comes back disappointed and empty-handed?
q.ur: Kaun si misaal us ke liye hai jo nakaam aur khali haath lautay?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَثَلٍ يُقالُ لِمَنْ يَعودُ خائِبًا خالِيَ اليَدَيْنِ؟

q.en: «مَواعِيدُ عُرْقُوب» is said about a person who...
q.ur: «مَواعِيدُ عُرْقُوب» kis ke liye bolte hain?

options: brings bad luck to his people
knows the truth of a matter

q.en: «الصَّيْفَ ضَيَّعْتِ اللَّبَن» is said to someone who...
q.ur: «الصَّيْفَ ضَيَّعْتِ اللَّبَن» kis ke liye bolte hain?

options: asks for something at the wrong time

q.en: «عَلى أَهْلِها جَنَتْ بَراقِش» is said to someone who...
q.ur: «عَلى أَهْلِها جَنَتْ بَراقِش» kis ke liye bolte hain?

options: brings trouble on himself and his family

intro.en: Here you practise the proverbs: fill the blanks, match each situation with the right proverb, and learn singular and plural words (for example قِصَّة – قِصَص, a story and stories). You also practise writing sentences like those in the text.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum misalon ki mashq karte hain: khali jagah bharna, har surat-e-haal ko sahi misaal se milana, aur wahid-jama seekhna (jaise قِصَّة – قِصَص, kahani aur kahaniyan). Matn jaise jumle likhne ki mashq bhi hai.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الأَمْثالِ: مَلْءُ الفَراغاتِ، وَمُطابَقَةُ كُلِّ مَوْقِفٍ بِالمَثَلِ المُناسِبِ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ (مِثْلَ قِصَّة – قِصَص). وَتَتَدَرَّبُ أَيْضًا عَلى كِتابَةِ جُمَلٍ مِثْلِ جُمَلِ النَّصِّ.

q.en: A man promises again and again but never gives. Which proverb fits?
q.ur: Ek aadmi bar bar wada karta hai magar deta nahi. Kaun si misaal munasib hai?
q.ar: رَجُلٌ يَعِدُ مَرَّةً بَعْدَ مَرَّةٍ وَلا يُعْطي شَيْئًا. أَيُّ مَثَلٍ يُناسِبُهُ؟

intro.en: «إِلّا» means 'except'. The word after it is called المُسْتَثْنى. In a full positive sentence it takes the accusative: حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً (the students came except one student). In a negative sentence you may use either case: ما حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً or طالِبٌ. If the thing excepted from is not mentioned, the word follows the verb's role: لَمْ يَحْضُرْ إِلّا طالِبٌ.
intro.ur: «إِلّا» ka matlab hai 'siwaye'. Iske baad wale lafz ko المُسْتَثْنى kehte hain. Musbat mukammal jumle mein yeh mansoob aata hai: حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً (taalib-e-ilm aaye siwaye ek ke). Manfi jumle mein dono surtein theek hain: طالِباً ya طالِبٌ. Agar jis se istisna ho woh zikr na ho to lafz jumle mein apne kaam ke mutabiq aata hai: لَمْ يَحْضُرْ إِلّا طالِبٌ.
intro.ar: «إِلّا» أَداةُ اسْتِثْناءٍ. وَالكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَها تُسَمّى المُسْتَثْنى. في الجُمْلَةِ المُثْبَتَةِ التّامَّةِ يُنْصَبُ: حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً. وَفي الجُمْلَةِ المَنْفِيَّةِ يَجوزُ النَّصْبُ وَالإِتْباعُ: ما حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً أَوْ طالِبٌ. وَإِذا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ المُسْتَثْنى مِنْهُ أَخَذَتِ الكَلِمَةُ إِعْرابَها بِحَسَبِ مَوْقِعِها: لَمْ يَحْضُرْ إِلّا طالِبٌ.

vocab.ur: woh lafz jis ka istisna ho

q.en: In «حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً», what does «إِلّا» mean?
q.ur: «حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً» mein «إِلّا» ka matlab?
q.ar: ما وَظيفَةُ «إِلّا» في «حَضَرَ الطُّلّابُ إِلّا طالِباً»؟

options_ar: أَداةُ اسْتِثْناءٍ تُخْرِجُ ما بَعْدَها مِنَ الحُكْمِ

q.en: In «لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ», the word after «إِلّا» is in the nominative because...
q.ur: «لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ» mein «إِلّا» ke baad marfu kyun hai?
q.ar: في «لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ» الكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَ «إِلّا» مَرْفوعَةٌ لِأَنَّ...

options: it is a negative sentence and the excepted word is a substitute
it is a full positive sentence
it comes after a question word only

q.en: The Arabic word for 'the exception' is...
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَدُلُّ عَلى «إِخْراجِ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الحُكْمِ»؟

intro.en: You listen to a text about proverbs and answer true/false and multiple-choice questions. Key ideas: proverbs give a clear picture of Arab life, and each proverb has a story. The second part is about the proverb «وَيْلٌ لِلشَّجِيِّ مِنَ الخَلِيِّ» and Aktham ibn Sayfi, who called his people to follow the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
intro.ur: Aap proverbs ke baare mein ek matn sunte hain aur sahi/ghalat aur chunao wale sawalat hal karte hain. Ahem baat: misalein Arab ki zindagi ki saaf tasveer deti hain aur har misaal ki ek kahani hoti hai. Doosra hissa «وَيْلٌ لِلشَّجِيِّ مِنَ الخَلِيِّ» aur Aktham bin Saifi ke baare mein hai jinhon ne apni qaum ko Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ki pairwi ki dawat di.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنِ الأَمْثالِ وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالاِخْتِيارِ مِنْ مُتَعَدِّدٍ. الفِكْرَةُ الرَّئيسَةُ: الأَمْثالُ تُعْطي صورَةً واضِحَةً عَنْ حَياةِ العَرَبِ، وَلِكُلِّ مَثَلٍ قِصَّةٌ. وَالجُزْءُ الثّاني عَنِ المَثَلِ «وَيْلٌ لِلشَّجِيِّ مِنَ الخَلِيِّ» وَأَكْثَمَ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ الَّذي دَعا قَوْمَهُ إِلى اتِّباعِ النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ.

options: has no sorrow in his heart

q.en: A short saying that has a story behind it is called...
q.ur: Mukhtasar qaul jis ke peeche kahani ho, kehlata hai...
q.ar: ما اسْمُ القَوْلِ المُوجَزِ الَّذي وَراءَهُ قِصَّةٌ؟

intro.en: Talk with a partner about proverbs: do all cultures have them, who writes them, and how do we benefit from them. Retell the six proverbs of the unit. Then discuss the meaning of six wise sayings, such as «لا وَرْدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَوْكٍ» (no rose without a thorn). Finally, summarise the opening text in your own words.
intro.ur: Apne saathi se misalon ke baare mein baat karein: kya har saqafat mein misalein hain, inhein kaun likhta hai, aur hum inse kaise faida uthate hain. Unit ki chhe misalon ki kahani sunayen. Phir chhe hikmat bhare jumlon ka matlab batayen, jaise «لا وَرْدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَوْكٍ» (kanton ke bina gulab nahin). Aakhir mein shuru ke matn ka khulasa apne alfaaz mein likhein.
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ الأَمْثالِ: هَلْ لِكُلِّ الثَّقافاتِ أَمْثالٌ؟ مَنْ يَكْتُبُها؟ وَكَيْفَ نَسْتَفيدُ مِنْها؟ ثُمَّ تَرْوي الأَمْثالَ السِّتَّةَ في الوَحْدَةِ، وَتُناقِشُ مَعاني سِتِّ حِكَمٍ مِثْلِ «لا وَرْدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَوْكٍ»، وَأَخيرًا تُلَخِّصُ النَّصَّ الأَوَّلَ بِأُسْلوبِكَ.

vocab.ur: tum bote ho – tum katte ho

q.ur: «لا وَرْدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَوْكٍ» ka matlab...
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لا وَرْدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَوْكٍ»؟

options_ar: كُلُّ نِعْمَةٍ يَصْحَبُها تَعَبٌ أَوْ صُعوبَةٌ
دَفْعُ الشَّرِّ قَبْلَ وُقوعِهِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ مُعالَجَتِهِ

options: as you sow, so you reap
necessity is the mother of invention

title.ur: Imla: «ما» ka milana aur alag likhna

intro.en: Rule 1: after a preposition, when «ما» is a question word it joins the preposition and loses its alif (مِمَّ، عَمَّ، فِيمَ، لِمَ، بِمَ، عَلامَ). When it is a relative word (that which), it stays separate: أَعْطِنِي مِمّا مَعَكَ. Rule 2: after إنَّ and its sisters and كُلّ, «ما» is written joined when it is just an addition (إنَّما، كَأَنَّما، كُلَّما) and separate when it means 'that which' (إنَّ ما بِعْتَهُ كَثِيرٌ).
intro.ur: Qaida 1: harf-e-jar ke baad agar «ما» sawaliya ho to preposition se mil jata hai aur alif girta hai (مِمَّ، عَمَّ، فِيمَ، لِمَ، بِمَ، عَلامَ); agar «ما» mausool ho (jo cheez) to alag likhte hain: أَعْطِنِي مِمّا مَعَكَ. Qaida 2: إنَّ aur uski behnon aur كُلّ ke baad agar «ما» sirf zaid hai to milate hain (إنَّما، كَأَنَّما، كُلَّما), aur agar matlab 'woh jo' ho to alag likhte hain (إنَّ ما بِعْتَهُ كَثِيرٌ).
intro.ar: القاعِدَةُ الأولى: بَعْدَ حَرْفِ الجَرِّ، إِذا كانَتْ «ما» اسْتِفْهامِيَّةً اتَّصَلَتْ بِهِ وَحُذِفَتْ أَلِفُها (مِمَّ، عَمَّ، فِيمَ، لِمَ، بِمَ، عَلامَ). وَإِذا كانَتْ بِمَعْنى «الَّذي» كُتِبَتْ مُنْفَصِلَةً: أَعْطِني مِمّا مَعَكَ. القاعِدَةُ الثّانِيَةُ: بَعْدَ إِنَّ وَأَخَواتِها وَكُلّ تُكْتَبُ «ما» مُتَّصِلَةً إِذا كانَتْ زائِدَةً (إِنَّما، كَأَنَّما، كُلَّما)، وَمُنْفَصِلَةً إِذا كانَتْ بِمَعْنى «الَّذي» (إِنَّ ما بِعْتَهُ كَثيرٌ).

q.en: «مِمَّ تَشْكُو؟» is a question. How is «مِمَّ» written?
q.ur: «مِمَّ تَشْكُو؟» sawal hai. «مِمَّ» kaise likha jata hai?

options: مِنْ + ما joined, as one word

q.en: Which sentence has «ما» as a relative word (separate)?
Which is written joined (just an addition)?
q.ur: Kaun sa milakar likha jata hai (sirf izafa)?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ كُتِبَتْ فيها «ما» مُتَّصِلَةً لِأَنَّها زائِدَةٌ؟

options: whenever you visit me, I honour you
options_ar: في كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ تَزورُني فيها أُكْرِمُكَ

intro.en: Arabic words are measured on a scale made of the letters ف ع ل (f-ʿ-l): the first root letter matches ف, the second ع, the third ل. So ضَرَبَ has the pattern فَعَلَ, شَرِبَ is فَعِلَ, and كَرُمَ is فَعُلَ. Extra letters stay as they are: سافَرَ is فاعَلَ, اِنْقَسَمَ is اِنْفَعَلَ, زَلْزَلَ is فَعْلَلَ. Dropped letters are dropped from the scale too: صُمْ is فُلْ.
intro.ur: Arabi alfaaz ko ف ع ل ke meezan par naapa jata hai: pehla asli harf ف, doosra ع, teesra ل. Is liye ضَرَبَ ka wazan فَعَلَ, شَرِبَ ka فَعِلَ aur كَرُمَ ka فَعُلَ hai. Zaid harf wese hi rehte hain: سافَرَ ka wazan فاعَلَ, اِنْقَسَمَ ka اِنْفَعَلَ, زَلْزَلَ ka فَعْلَلَ. Jo harf gir jaye woh meezan se bhi girta hai: صُمْ ka wazan فُلْ.
intro.ar: تُقاسُ الكَلِماتُ العَرَبِيَّةُ عَلى مِيزانٍ مِنَ الحُروفِ ف ع ل: الحَرْفُ الأَصْلِيُّ الأَوَّلُ يُقابِلُ الفاءَ، وَالثّاني العَيْنَ، وَالثّالِثُ اللّامَ. فَـ«ضَرَبَ» عَلى وَزْنِ فَعَلَ، وَ«شَرِبَ» عَلى فَعِلَ، وَ«كَرُمَ» عَلى فَعُلَ. وَالحُروفُ الزّائِدَةُ تَبْقى كَما هِيَ: «سافَرَ» فاعَلَ، «اِنْقَسَمَ» اِنْفَعَلَ، «زَلْزَلَ» فَعْلَلَ. وَالحُروفُ المَحْذوفَةُ تُحْذَفُ مِنَ المِيزانِ: «صُمْ» فُلْ.
